coverage.review_scope: Disposition coverage includes explicit unreviewed reserves and is not full body review of the search pool.

input_aliases.source: Official API redirect observed during 2026-11-09 fixed-object triage

rejected_or_held.reason: Today fixed tree has no SKILL.md and README is a two-line repository title/description. Root Apache grant exists, but no concrete public skill or implemented skill infrastructure/distribution is present for admission.

Complete root representative, README distribution and MIT grant were read. Concrete report packaging exists, but instructions mandate demonstrating harm using other people's non-public data/business state, require unredacted sensitive evidence, and contain conflicting preserve-user-edits versus full-document-rebuild directions. Those requirements create unresolved authorization/privacy and data-preservation boundaries; hold consumer admission until a bounded authorized-test-data and edit-preservation contract is clarified. No targets contacted, exploit verification, document generation or helpers executed.

rejected_or_held.description: Turn any AI coding assistant into a self-checking senior engineer: multi-round, multi-dimension code review → fix → re-verify, repeating until the change converges. Works with Trae, Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Codex and 25+ assistants.
rejected_or_held.summary_en: Portable multi-round code review/fix skill with onboarding, defensive-mode guards, local Git isolation and opt-in merge/push.
rejected_or_held.summary_zh: 可移植的多轮代码审阅与修复技能，提供项目初始化、防御模式校验、本地 Git 隔离及可选合并推送。
rejected_or_held.count_basis: Three exact SKILL.md paths: one public consumer root SKILL.md; two hidden iterate-harness guides (harness-eval and pr-merge) are author-maintenance workflows and excluded. Assistant prompt adapters, CLI subcommands, review dimensions, embedded harness and dsh plugin are components/copies, not additional public native skills.
rejected_or_held.distribution_evidence: README explicitly publishes npx installer, complete-directory manual installation and source-script routes, and separates root conversational skill from embedded/separate headless harness and dsh plugin. pyproject.toml defines the iterate CLI; cordis patch packages the separate plugin. Full 61,132-character / 91,811-byte selected representative was read, plus README purpose/install/security/license portions and complete default config/root MIT.
rejected_or_held.license_scope: Full root MIT covers authored core skill and CLI. No root-near override/NOTICE applies to root SKILL.md in the fixed tree. Embedded harness/plugin/installer have separate local LICENSE files and external model/provider/dependency terms; their behavior and aggregate redistribution are not certified by this core-instruction review.
rejected_or_held.reason: Hold for a concrete, statically observed rollback-contract defect despite clear public distribution and MIT: Phase 3 failure uses the current-round backup tag before Phase 5 creates it only after successful validation. The tag name also lacks session identity. A first failing round can therefore have no referenced tag, while a later session may resolve the same name to an old tag. Upstream correction/clarification is needed before recommending this autonomous Git-modifying workflow.

static_findings.issue: Failure rollback consumes iterate/round-{round}-backup before the documented creation point after validation. No earlier creation step appears in the fully read representative.
static_findings.effect: Rollback may fail because the tag is absent, or reset the iteration branch to an older session tag; this was not executed.

static_findings.issue: Whole-worktree git restore/reset paths are described as non-destructive. They discard tracked working-tree/index edits in the isolated branch and are not scoped to the individual task paths.
static_findings.effect: Isolation reduces impact on the original checkout but does not preserve unrelated edits introduced within the iteration worktree; no loss was induced here.

rejected_or_held.runtime_scope: The root declares file read/write, shell, Git and release-download network permissions. It runs configured validation commands and commits each passing round; architecture edits need approval and default config has auto_merge:false and push_per_round:false. Default max_rounds is 7 with documented hard cap 50. Installer also installs a CLI on PATH. Embedded harness/plugin can run headless/desktop loops, but their background polling/watchers and actual permission enforcement were not audited or started.
rejected_or_held.limitations: Static instruction/config review only. No candidate script, installer, CLI, validation test, Git tag/reset/restore, model session, remote provider, background loop, hook, plugin or CI workflow executed. Advertised security/signature/compatibility/convergence guarantees remain source claims.
rejected_or_held.review_scope: Complete selected representative, complete default config/root MIT, bounded README distribution/use/security/license portions and two small package declarations. Not a runtime audit or complete embedded harness/plugin source review.

rejected_or_held.reason: Today README and complete fingering representative establish a consumer-distributed hosted MCP plugin with two skill files. Root LICENSE is only 237 bytes: an abbreviated MIT-labelled permission sentence without the standard instrument, with undefined capitalized Software. README badge/frontmatter do not cure the incomplete grant; hold rights-scope clarification rather than asserting standard MIT or copying the body.

README explicitly describes Agent Reach as third-party material added into this project, not its website server or an installed external product. All fifteen raw paths are hidden project skill copies; the complete selected Agent Reach file even retains unsubstituted template placeholders. No independently consumer-distributed skill pack or implemented skill infrastructure scope is established.

Root SKILL.md is a repository-specific workflow for implementing/registering portal adapters and maintaining the device app, not a separately installed consumer skill. README links it as an extension-development document. Layered GPLv3/MIT licensing is present and is not the rejection reason.

The complete root SKILL.md is explicitly for GNU Bash compatibility maintenance in this repository, naming captain-owned files, private handoff artifacts and test ledgers. README only mentions it as a repo disclosure; no independent consumer-distributed skill contract was established.

README install, releases and branding point to genspark-ai/genoffice, already in the baseline under a different identity. The 43 raw skills have a real app/CLI consumer contract and a complete budget-planner sample was read, but distinct independent maintenance/distribution of this tender-os identity is not established. Root Apache-2.0 has ee enterprise and NOTICE asset exceptions; not held for missing license.

Official API resolves the old search name to tech-writing-skills under the same stable ID. Fixed README has a real two-task consumer installation contract but explicitly states no repository license is specified; the complete tree has no license/notice paths. This is a scoped permission gap, not an inference from API NOASSERTION.

README identifies an automatically generated catalog mirror, with 528 raw skill paths and per-upstream licensing distinct from MIT packaging. Public delivery and benchmarking claims exist, but this bounded review did not reconcile imported source identities, package scope and the heterogeneous leaf license inventory; a cached 21868-byte A/B-test file is not a completed substantive representative review. Not admitted as 528 original skills or as zero-native infrastructure without a reviewed implementation.

Fixed README describes a large consumer onboarding/workflow distribution, with 93 raw SKILL.md paths mixing upstream-original copies, platform adapters, fixtures, backups and numbered tasks. No root license exists in the complete tree; four nested license/notice paths cover only specific subpackages. A whole-pack count and applicable instruction licensing were not established; nested grants are not treated as a blanket license.

Complete amcp-hivemind-swarm guide and README/AGPL notice were read. README directs skill consumers to the separate HiveMind-AMCP-Collaboration repository, while the local paths also include cloud operations and a zero-stub maintenance gate. Distinct consumer distribution/canonical relation for this identity is unresolved. Model availability, VRAM/preemption and swarm privacy claims are unverified; not held for missing license.

rejected_or_held.description: Benchmark for evaluating coding agents on real combinatorial-optimization solver improvements
rejected_or_held.reason: A general coding-agent combinatorial-solver benchmark. README only allows optional externally installed profile skills/plugins; the fixed complete tree contains no SKILL.md distribution. Solver plugins are evaluator adapters, not agent skills.

rejected_or_held.description: The live, open benchmark for mountain snowfall forecasting: ~2,400 QC'd snow stations & ski resorts, scored daily against ECMWF, GFS, NOAA and friends. Humans, ML models and AI agents welcome.
rejected_or_held.reason: Snowfall forecasting benchmark/data competition. README uses skill as forecast accuracy, not reusable agent instructions; complete tree has no SKILL.md or skill/plugin distribution.

Education-sector research/market knowledge base and extensive audit notes/fixtures. No SKILL.md in complete tree; inspected README is a pass ledger, not a public reusable skill/installer contract. Root project grant also absent; embedded fixture licenses do not license this knowledge base.

A pretraining-data-mixture literature-insight collection, not public agent skill distribution. README describes papers/docs; complete tree has no SKILL.md and no root license. Paper evaluations are not independently validated here.

README directs Claude skill/plugin consumers to the separate esbmc/agent-marketplace repository. Main recursive tree is truncated; nonrecursive root and README/COPYING were fetched, but this identity's own reusable skill distribution is not established. No assertion of a complete skill census.

README and full actor/component representative establish public skill content (76 paths), but complete tree has no applicable root or near LICENSE/NOTICE grant. Hold for instruction licensing, without inferring permissions from UE documentation links.

README and full grant-deep-research representative establish three bundled Claude skills, but complete tree has no root or scoped license grant. NGO/public-benefit purpose and public visibility are not reuse permission.

README and full Apple Notes representative establish a skill collection, but no root license exists and only five unrelated local skill folders carry LICENSE files. Representative frontmatter says MIT without a full applicable grant; collection-wide provenance/license scope remains unclosed.

Different repository ID but README installation, author attribution and plugin source point to Yuan1z0825/nature-skills, already in baseline. Fixed router/root MIT read; no independent maintenance or distribution value beyond this mirrored source has been established, so not counted as a novel independent admission.

rejected_or_held.description: Cortex Code and Claude Code skills for Geo Data Connector — Snowflake Native App
rejected_or_held.reason: Complete 89,093-character representative contains conflicting operational contracts: omitted schedule is said to default to immediate On-demand, then later to disable forever; it calls GDC_TASK(info) although enumerated actions only include get/list/runs and declares exactly four procedures against README's five. Hold pending upstream contract clarification; paid-edition prerequisite is recorded, not itself a rejection reason.

rejected_or_held.description: Write a diagram as text, get a drawing that looks hand-made — and can draw itself step by step.
rejected_or_held.reason: Complete hidden .claude/skills/inkling guide and MIT read. It is a usable diagram-authoring recipe with repository-relative checker, but checked README distribution/editor/layout/license sections publish only the product library/CLI/LSP, not an explicit consumer skill route; AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md absent. Hold until public skill-delivery/consumer scope is established. This is not a claim of no license or that all hidden skills are maintenance. No diagram rendering, installation or checker execution.
